_doc: Per-uid audit of the 158 Toyota audit sheets in car-meshes/audit/toyota/, judged against the owner's rubric in CLAUDE.md and the 2026-08-09 glazing and tyre rulings, which post-date the original Toyota wave. 115 of the 158 sheets have a staged GLB and were audited in full; the other 43 are exactly the 43 uids already in REJECTS.json, whose GLBs were pruned. Glazing is decided ONLY from the glTF via pipeline/ingest/glass_probe.py -- the sheet cannot witness it, because render/handler.py forces transmission=1.0 onto any glass-NAMED material. Where the file names NO glazing material the probe returns certainty=inferred, no override can fire, and the sheet IS admissible; those were judged by eye. 'ambiguous' is never treated as a fail.

_verdicts.fail-rerender: the ASSET is sound; the render worker inverted it. Deterministic per file -- re-rendering on the same build will not fix it. Never a scrap.
